name: Immoral Bargain
oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice X creatures.
Destroy X target nonland permanents.
blocked_sentences: As an additional cost to cast this spell, sacrifice X creatures.

needs.what: a spell's own card-level target spec whose count is exactly the number of times its repeatable additional cost was paid (here {"additional_paid": true}, the number of creatures sacrificed, 0 included), fixed per cast line so legality enumerates X target nonland permanents for each X the board can pay
needs.why_existing_wont_do: TargetModel.count accepts a value expression only on an ability's targets; loader.targets._compile_targets refuses one on a card's own targets because a spell's targets are enumerated before the additional cost is paid and would read zero. count: "any" lets the caster pick a target count unrelated to the sacrifices (strictly better card), and a fixed count with additional_repeatable cannot tie the two together

needs.what: an additional cost 'sacrifice X creatures' where X may be 0 and is bounded only by the creatures you control, read back by the effect as X
needs.why_existing_wont_do: additional_cost {sacrifice: Creature} with additional_repeatable and additional_optional is the nearest shape (Plumb the Forbidden), but casting.MAX_ADDITIONAL_TIMES caps repeats, so X above that cap is unreachable; on its own it is expressible, but it is useless without the target count above
